examples.title: Example 1: Setting Rendering and Effect Strategies
examples.description: This example demonstrates different rendering and effect strategies using renderingStrategy and effectStrategy, available since API version 11.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting Symbol and Shadow Effects
examples.description: This example demonstrates various symbol effects using the symbolEffect attribute (available since API version 12) and shadow effects with symbolShadow (available since API version 20).

examples.title: Example 3: Setting Gradient Color Effects
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to apply gradient colors to SymbolGlyph components using the shaderStyle API, available since API version 20.
